sequence.description: Strictly monotonic 1-based sequence incrementing by 1 for each line.

request_id.description: Globally unique decision request identifier echoing Core attempt/round.

request_sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of request file bytes.

response_sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of response file bytes; null for request_published.

wall_clock_iso.description: Contemporaneous UTC ISO-8601 wall-clock timestamp at record append.

prev_record_hash.description: SHA-256 of previous line's canonical payload; '0'*64 for line 1.

record_hash.description: SHA-256 over canonical JSON of this record's fields.
